title: Staff / Lead Full Stack Engineer
summary: Accomplished Staff Full Stack Architect with 7+ years delivering fault-tolerant microservices, modern React/TypeScript user interfaces, and automated CI/CD cloud infrastructures. Reduced latency by 42% and scaled platforms to 5M+ monthly active users.
sampleStrongBullets: Spearheaded redesign of core checkout flow using React, TypeScript, and Redis caching, boosting conversion rates by 28% and generating $4.2M in annualized revenue.
Architected event-driven microservices with Node.js and Apache Kafka, handling 45,000 requests/sec with 99.99% uptime SLA.
Engineered zero-downtime Kubernetes CI/CD pipeline on AWS, cutting build and deployment cycle times from 45 minutes to 4.2 minutes (90% reduction).
Mentored 8 mid-level engineers, resulting in 3 internal promotions to Senior Engineer within 12 months.
